items.claim: average() divides by len(prices) without checking for an empty list, so it raises ZeroDivisionError on exactly the case its docstring and the PR body call common (new, empty carts).
items.consequence: The summary panel renders a newly created cart: average([]) -> total([]) / len([]) -> 0 / 0 -> ZeroDivisionError, and the panel crashes instead of showing 0.0 (or None). Fix: `if not prices: return 0.0` (or return Optional[float]) before dividing.

items.claim: The new average() function ships without any tests, in particular none for the empty-cart case the PR says is common.
items.consequence: test_pricing.py only imports apply_discount and total. A test_average([]) case would have caught the ZeroDivisionError above, and without one the crash on new carts passes CI and reaches the summary panel.
